verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּעָזְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמַח־ מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ֝בִישׁ֥וּעָתְךָ֗ מַה־ מְאֹֽד׃ יָּ֥גֶיל
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh bə·‘āz·zə·ḵā yiś·maḥ- me·leḵ ū·ḇî·šū·‘ā·ṯə·ḵā mah- mə·’ōḏ yå̄·ḡɛl
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David O LORD the king rejoices in Your strength How greatly he exults in Your salvation
verses.literalPt: O REI se alegra em tua força, SENHOR; e na tua salvação grandemente se regozija.

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּוֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ וַאֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו בַּל־ מָנַ֥עְתָּ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ta·’ă·waṯ lib·bōw nā·ṯat·tāh lōw wa·’ă·re·šeṯ śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw bal- mā·na‘·tā se·lāh
verses.literal: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips Selah
verses.literalPt: Cumpriste-lhe o desejo do seu coração, e não negaste as súplicas dos seus lábios. (Selá.)

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תְ֭קַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯə·qad·də·men·nū bir·ḵō·wṯ ṭō·wḇ tā·šîṯ lə·rō·šōw ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ pāz
verses.literal: For You welcomed him with rich blessings You placed on his head a crown of pure gold
verses.literalPt: Pois vais ao seu encontro com as bênçãos de bondade; pões na sua cabeça uma coroa de ouro fino.

verses.original: חַיִּ֤ים׀ שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay·yîm šā·’al mim·mə·ḵā nā·ṯat·tāh lōw ’ō·reḵ yā·mîm ‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: He asked You for . . . life and You granted it length of days forever and ever
verses.literalPt: Vida te pediu, e lha deste, mesmo longura de dias para sempre e eternamente.

verses.original: גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: gā·ḏō·wl kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw bî·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā hō·wḏ wə·hā·ḏār tə·šaw·weh ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Great is his glory in Your salvation You bestow on him splendor and majesty
verses.literalPt: Grande é a sua glória pela tua salvação; glória e majestade puseste sobre ele.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תְשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָעַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥הוּ בְ֝שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת־ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯə·šî·ṯê·hū ḇə·rā·ḵō·wṯ lā·‘aḏ tə·ḥad·dê·hū ḇə·śim·ḥāh ’eṯ- pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: For You grant him blessings forever . . . You cheer him with joy in Your presence
verses.literalPt: Pois o abençoaste para sempre; tu o enches de gozo com a tua face.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל־ יִמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ham·me·leḵ bō·ṭê·aḥ Yah·weh ū·ḇə·ḥe·seḏ ‘el·yō·wn bal- yim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: For the king trusts in the LORD through the loving devotion of the Most High he will not be shaken
verses.literalPt: Porque o rei confia no SENHOR, e pela misericórdia do Altíssimo nunca vacilará.

verses.original: תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְךָ לְכָל־ אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יְ֝מִֽינְךָ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tim·ṣā yā·ḏə·ḵā lə·ḵāl ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā yə·mî·nə·ḵā tim·ṣā śō·nə·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies Your right hand will seize those who hate You
verses.literalPt: A tua mão alcançará todos os teus inimigos, a tua mão direita alcançará aqueles que te odeiam.

verses.original: תְּשִׁיתֵ֤מוֹ׀ כְּתַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְעֵ֪ת פָּ֫נֶ֥יךָ יְ֭הוָה בְּאַפּ֣וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑ם וְֽתֹאכְלֵ֥ם אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·šî·ṯê·mōw kə·ṯan·nūr ’êš lə·‘êṯ pā·ne·ḵā Yah·weh bə·’ap·pōw yə·ḇal·lə·‘êm wə·ṯō·ḵə·lêm ’êš
verses.literal: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing In His wrath the LORD will engulf them and the fire will consume them
verses.literalPt: Tu os farás como um forno de fogo no tempo da tua ira; o SENHOR os devorará na sua indignação, e o fogo os consumirá.

verses.original: פִּ֭רְיָמוֹ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.literal: You will wipe their descendants from the earth and their offspring from the sons of men
verses.literalPt: Seu fruto destruirás da terra, e a sua semente dentre os filhos dos homens.

verses.original: כִּי־ נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל־ יוּכָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- nā·ṭū ‘ā·le·ḵā rā·‘āh ḥā·šə·ḇū mə·zim·māh bal- yū·ḵā·lū
verses.literal: Though they intend You harm the schemes they devise will not prevail
verses.literalPt: Porque intentaram o mal contra ti; maquinaram um ardil, mas não prevalecerão.

verses.original: כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝מֵֽיתָרֶ֗יךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî tə·šî·ṯê·mōw še·ḵem bə·mê·ṯā·re·ḵā tə·ḵō·w·nên ‘al- pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: For You will put them to flight . . . when Your bow is trained upon them
verses.literalPt: Assim que tu lhes farás voltar as costas; e com tuas flechas postas nas cordas lhes apontarás ao rosto.

verses.original: ר֣וּמָה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעֻזֶּ֑ךָ נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝נְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: rū·māh Yah·weh ḇə·‘uz·ze·ḵā nā·šî·rāh ū·nə·zam·mə·rāh gə·ḇū·rā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Be exalted O LORD in Your strength we will sing and praise Your power
verses.literalPt: Exalta-te, SENHOR, na tua força; então cantaremos e louvaremos o teu poder.
